name: Bauernhof Bichlhof
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Bichlhof in Ebbs is an inn in Tirol. The farm offers accommodations and dining. The rural location allows relaxation in nature. Regional products from its own production are offered. The surroundings of Ebbs are suitable for hiking and cycling tours. The city of Kufstein with its fortress is nearby. The Bichlhof is a typical Tiroler inn with an agricultural character.
